headline: Spotify says it pulled 50 million AI slop tracks from recommendations
summary: Spotify says it removed more than 50 million songs it considers AI-generated 'slop' or spam from user recommendations over the past year and adjusted its recommendation system to favor human-made music. One outlet notes the tracks were pulled from recommendations but not necessarily deleted from the platform entirely.
